assumptions: Local execution environment and recorded versions are accurate.
limitations: External runtime, security, legal and human qualification remain outside this package.
confidence: high for repository-local exercised evidence; low for external production qualification
independentVerificationStatus: internal role-separated adversarial validation; external certification pending

requirements.statement: Signed material must use strict deterministic canonicalization and reject ambiguous or hidden values.
Binary inputs must use an explicit byte-domain hash API.
Replay consumption must persist across restart and reject concurrent duplicate consumption.
Telemetry must bound retention, cardinality and attributes, preserve privacy and fail readiness closed.
Critical operational actions require evidence-bound closure and dual-control waiver.
Critical invariants must map to implementation, tests, mutation/adversarial control, monitor, incident and evidence.
Portable archives must be deterministic, non-executable and reject traversal, links and path collisions.
Dependencies must be exact, integrity-bound, script-free and sourced only from explicit registry allowlists.
Every source test must be scheduled exactly once, compiled and counted from executed TAP.
Production promotion requires external durable-runtime, custody, isolation, security, legal, human and SLO qualification.
Governed model execution shall be authority-bound, budgeted, injection-filtered, evidence-linked and proposal-only.
Engineering assistance shall independently verify model receipts and shall not approve or execute its own proposals.
Release shall block on source cycles, untested source nodes or open declared capability paths.
Critical design claims shall close design, implementation, integration, test, mutation, recovery, operational control and evidence references.
Registry advisory unavailability shall be reported as environment-blocked and never as zero vulnerabilities.
Release shall maintain at least 96 percent branch coverage in the declared in-process scope without excluding critical source modules.
Agent proposals shall reject policy, security, test and dependency lockfile targets before approval or execution.
Branch-security closure shall be supported by adversarial tests and targeted mutation evidence for authority, identity, KMS, recertification, domain admission and runtime denial.
Repository changes must be represented by a deterministic semantic dependency graph with bounded blast radius and explicit evidence obligations.
Side-effecting operations must have complete, tenant-bound, digest-linked audit evidence including authorization, receipt and exactly one terminal event.
Model use must fail closed for unknown, retired, blocked, purpose-incompatible or time-effectively retired models.
Canonical root documents and all governance registries must exist and share the current program version.
Measurement and scientific claims must preserve observation class, tolerance, uncertainty and safety-critical simulation limits.
Payment-domain transitions must remain provider-neutral, idempotent, signed-webhook gated, tenant-bound and non-authoritative without licensed adapters.
Concurrent file-store publication must never expose partially written canonical JSON to competing processes.
Every release must evaluate exactly fourteen weighted project and cycle execution axes, preserve blockers and track deltas.
Promotion-critical evidence must match the current source digest, artifact digest and freshness window.
Source modules must remain within explicit complexity and coupling budgets or carry a blocking decomposition decision.
Critical capabilities must map to explicit failure modes and passing scenario evidence.
Human and commercial value claims require predefined hypotheses, minimum samples and measured human evidence.
Performance regressions must be normalized, budgeted and separated from external production SLO qualification.
Production source complexity must pass with zero warnings and zero blocks after refactoring.
External evidence must be OBSERVED, independently reviewed, signature verified and bound to source and artifact digests.
HSM/KMS, monotonic witness, PostgreSQL HA/PITR, human pilot, independent review and multi-host SLO evidence must each be evaluated fail closed.
The aggregate external qualification gate must remain blocked unless all six distinct gates pass.
Passing all evidence gates may only make promotion eligible for an authorized decision; it must never promote automatically.
Simulation, self-review, unsigned evidence, identity drift and source-digest mismatch must be rejected.
Architecture closure must include all external qualification interfaces with zero cycles and zero untested source modules.
The fourteen-axis scorecard must preserve external blockers and track readiness improvements without claiming external execution.
Every changed artifact must bind to a requirement, owner, test, evidence, rollback and independent review.
Critical state transitions must be checked against a declarative monotonic model.
Critical capabilities must have risk-distributed adversarial technique coverage.
Trust compromise blast radius must remain tenant- and scope-bounded without wildcard authority.
Every atomic publication crash point must recover to prior or committed state without duplicate side effects.
Architecture must preserve zero cycles, zero layer violations, zero duplicate authorities and zero untested modules.
Every release claim must close through current authentic complete acyclic evidence.
Representative product paths must meet local p95, throughput, heap and sample budgets.
Reproducibility must bind source, artifact, seed, clock, locale, runtime and environment allowlist.
Recovery exercises must include detection, containment, recovery, recertification and RTO.
Observed portability claims must remain separate from planned targets.
Irreversible operator actions must be confirmed and recoverable while workflow effort is measured.
External qualification must be dependency-ordered with separate collectors and reviewers.
Every changed file must map to impacted capabilities and tests, with full-suite escalation for critical changes.
Maintainability must be measured through ownership, documentation, test ratio, complexity, deprecation and change-failure budgets.
Critical journeys must expose correlated logs, metrics, traces, SLOs, alerts, runbooks and redaction.
Governed data assets must carry purpose, tenant scope, lineage, integrity, retention, deletion, restore, encryption and access-review evidence.
Dependencies must be exact-pinned, integrity-verified, license-allowed, upgrade-tested and replaceable when critical.
Migrations must be forward-tested, rollback-tested, idempotent, checksum-verified, tenant-safe and dry-runnable.
Personal and sensitive data must be necessary, lawfully grounded, encrypted when persisted, redacted in logs and deletable.
Operator flows must be keyboard-complete, labeled, focus-safe, contrast-checked, recoverable and confirm destructive actions.
Representative workloads must have explicit throughput, latency, heap, cost and capacity-headroom budgets.
The holistic score must retain the fourteen core axes as promotion-critical and must not dilute external blockers.
Critical claims must be supported by diverse proof techniques, independent oracles, multiple environments and observed evidence.
Critical integration edges must prove success, rejection, timeout, replay, concurrency, tamper, rollback, tenant isolation and observability.
Integration fault campaigns must cover timeout, duplicate, reorder, tamper, partial write, dependency outage and tenant confusion without unsafe residual effects.
Release assurance must aggregate all local proofs while remaining unable to promote production.
Third-party tools must remain adapter-only until immutable origin, license and execution evidence are independently verified.
Security scan evidence must be imported as trusted digest-bound SARIF and active error findings must fail closed.
Artifact provenance must require a trusted builder, signer, materials, signature and transparency verification.
Policy evidence must be deterministic, observed and fail closed on deny or undefined decisions.
Formal evidence must bind specification, implementation and refinement and reject deadlocks or invariant violations.
Fuzz evidence must be observed, reproducible, sufficiently broad and free of crash or sanitizer findings.
All material claims must survive adversarial review for self-review, digest drift, correlated oracles and unsupported external inference.
GitHub workflows must use full immutable action SHAs, isolated checkout credentials, least privilege and bounded artifact retention.
Strategic aggregation must distinguish BLOCK from NOT_EXECUTED and must never grant production promotion.
Execute a native static security scan that emits digest-bound SARIF evidence.
Generate and verify ephemeral Ed25519 in-toto provenance without persisting private keys.
Evaluate deterministic release policy and fail closed on deny or undefined input.
Explore bounded release states and prove production authorization invariants.
Run deterministic seeded fuzzing against a real evidence gate.
Maintain and verify a local monotonic witness chain while preserving the external-independence blocker.
Record every authoritative validation step in an atomic run-scoped ledger with command, order, timestamps, exit status and produced artifact digests.
Reject stale, replayed, out-of-order, timed-out, aborted, path-unsafe or digest-mismatched evidence.
Bind governance status, current evidence paths and external qualification target to the exact current version.
Minimize paid execution through tenant-bound exact and semantic cache, deterministic rules, local models, deduplication and bounded external fallback.
Select the lowest-cost topology only when database redundancy, reserved capacity, witness, backup, provider and failure-domain floors remain satisfied.
Scale local workers to zero and request burst capacity only through proposal-only, sovereign, allowlisted, sensitivity-bounded and budget-bounded plans.
Convert high-complexity work into max-reasoning diverse-role stages with just-in-time context and causal proof obligations.
Treat binary files as bounded proof-carrying artifacts with deterministic structure, chunk, Merkle, policy and lineage evidence plus an independent verifier.
Refuse world-best or frontier claims unless permitted observed evidence satisfies every critical comparative dimension.
Compare model entries through a preregistered blinded corpus with signed provider submissions, signed independent judges, cost bounds, reveal commitments and out-of-band trust.
Admit and compose WASM components only when exact binary, WIT interfaces, capability grants, source, toolchain, policy, publisher and independent review evidence agree.
Production multi-host qualification requires signed fresh observations from externally pinned independent hosts, providers and organizations bound to one authoritative identity tuple.
Execute admitted WebAssembly bytes only after deterministic parent-process validation of imports, run export and one measurable memory export, with bounded worker timeout and memory limits.
External tournament transport evidence must be signed by an out-of-band authorized observer independent of the model provider and bound to exact request, response and external response identity.
Local failover proof must use distinct processes, real HTTP requests, acknowledged replication, measured RTO and RPO, and verified child-process cleanup while remaining explicitly non-production.
Private building-block components require exact Dapr-profile interfaces, trusted SPIFFE domain, UDS transport, resource limits, source and policy digests, and independent review.
All eight building blocks require portable semantic conformance and at least two admissible implementation choices before a no-lock-in claim.
Production qualification requires actual pinned CNCF runtimes and external evidence; contract fixtures can satisfy only local dry-run readiness.
Retries require bounded timeout idempotency circuit breaker bulkhead and worst-case execution duration.
Durable execution requires one run and workflow identity monotonic hash-chained history valid transitions and unique effect ownership.
Workload identity requires node and workload attestation selector binding SVID freshness and federation evidence for foreign trust domains.
Telemetry cost reduction must preserve error security latency and tenant-minimum traces and expose mandatory budget overrun.
PostgreSQL continuity requires observed replica lag synchronous replica backup WAL restore and failover evidence.
When the outgoing coordinator is unavailable, takeover requires expired lease plus safety delay, three distinct witness votes, exact term and sequence continuity, and an irreversible fencing token.

requirements.requirement: External monitor qualification must bind TLS pin, time quorum, durable receipt and signed host evidence; labels alone must not establish external topology.

requirements.statement: External qualification execution shall be bound to a signed deployment manifest with public DNS and eleven separated role owners.
Evidence import shall require a fresh expiring challenge and exact byte inventory with no missing or additional files.
A separate recovery verifier shall restore and attest one durable receipt before evidence acceptance.
Local rehearsal evidence shall never be relabelled as live external evidence and shall never grant production authority.
The exact eleven external qualification roles shall complete fresh one-time challenge-response provisioning before ceremony closure.
The custody ceremony transcript shall be immutable, complete and witnessed by at least two separated observers.
Every key rotation or revocation shall be recomputed from the original proposal, key-possession statements and independent security approvals, and revoked keys shall not be resurrected.
Provisioning, ceremony, lifecycle and import receipts shall be committed to an append-only witnessed transparency log; no local rehearsal shall grant production authority.
All eleven custody role keys shall carry signed hardware-provider attestations proving generated-in-device non-extractable key custody and fail-closed signing semantics.
Custody-sensitive operations shall require a monotonic three-of-five threshold certificate with distinct custodians and predecessor continuity.
Public checkpoint retrieval and revocation propagation shall be witnessed by three monitors and reject rollback, split-view and revoked-key resurrection.
Site-loss recovery shall restore exact bytes while preserving checkpoint and sequence continuity without fork, reset or production authority.
Adapter manifests shall bind exact module bytes provider interface ABI signing mechanisms and conformance-vector digest.
Remote attestations shall bind original document and challenge bytes role key device firmware and adapter provider, rejecting reuse and expiry.
Threshold checkpoint authorization shall require three of five separated custodians across at least three providers and organizations.
Checkpoint retrieval and cross-site recovery shall preserve exact bytes and sequence continuity across separated monitors sites and providers without production authority.
Provider onboarding shall bind exact signed trust-root certificate and adapter module bytes to approved registrars, policies and validity windows.
Independent conformance shall reverify adapter and attestation signatures and bind device session nonce token serial test vector and non-extractability controls.
Attestation revocation and provider replacement shall be monotonic, require three separated custodians, fence the old provider and preserve the five-provider set.
Checkpoint monitoring and cross-site recovery shall preserve exact bytes and sequence continuity across three monitors and distinct providers without production authority.
All package-lock dependency resolutions shall point to repository-local capsule tarballs with matching integrity values.
The complete dependency set shall install with npm ci offline from an empty cache and build without external tool injection.
SBOM and toolchain provenance shall bind exact capsule and project bytes and remain independently verifiable.
Every capsule tarball shall have an exact signed and sequenced provenance statement.
Vulnerability intelligence shall be signed, monotonic, current and bound to exact provenance digests.
Revocation, rollback and replacement shall preserve package identity, verified base continuity and empty-cache offline reproducibility.
Dependency update selection shall be deterministic under a signed policy and bound to exact candidate, provenance and graph-impact digests.
A multi-package update shall bind every package mutation, conflict resolution, rehearsal, approval and canary report into one atomic transaction manifest.
Interrupted or failed updates shall deterministically select partial or full rollback and restore a durable base without fork or residual partial state.
Every transaction coordinator action shall append a signed, contiguous and durably fsynced journal entry under the current fencing authority.
Expired coordinator failover shall require three independent witnesses, irreversible fencing, idempotent replay and exact sequence continuation.
Coordinator qualification shall require independently described hosts, signed clock quorum and three byte-identical durable journal replicas before and after failover.
Partition failover and site-loss recovery shall preserve the exact journal head, fencing sequence, append-only bytes and production authority NONE.

requirements.requirement: External coordinator deployment must bind sixteen separated roles, public DNS coverage and exact base qualification digest.
Evidence import must verify one-time challenge, exact file inventory, two-auditor infrastructure quorum and durable store recovery.
Every ceremony role must receive a fresh authority-signed enrollment package and return a role-bound one-time possession response.
Interrupted ceremonies must be revocable by three separated custodians and exact evidence transfer must be challenge-bound, inventory-complete and replay protected.
Every ceremony role must submit through a fresh mutually authenticated channel, exact authority-signed roster binding and malware quarantine.
External readiness requires sixteen clean role receipts, twenty-two trusted infrastructure attestations and quorum-authorized replacement for any unavailable role holder.
Every quarantined role receipt must enter an organization-isolated queue and receive two independent signed review decisions before approval.
Disputes require revision-linked resubmission and readiness requires four monotonic quorum snapshots, sixteen approvals and twenty-two external attestations.
Every queue mutation must be signed, sequence-linked, fenced by a valid worker lease, idempotent and replicated as exact bytes to three separated durable stores.
Crash recovery and audit replay must preserve the journal prefix, enforce pressure hysteresis and keep external readiness and production authority blocked.
Persistence qualification must require three separated exact-byte queue stores, two separated workers, two clocks and witnessed partition failover.
Overload rejection, hysteresis clear and site-loss audit replay must be verified while production and external claims remain fail closed.
Qualification execution must bind ten unique roles to one-time enrollment challenges and isolated process attestations.
Each role requires two independent audits and the evidence bundle must contain portable exact-file inventory for all three drills.
Each execution-role evidence package must be encrypted independently with AES-256-GCM and 2-of-3 threshold recovery.
Custody transfer, quarantine, decryption, revocation and recovery must be bound to one monotonic signed ledger.
Every custody-authority action must be committed to a replicated monotonic ledger under an active fenced lease.
Share rotation, compromise containment, emergency quorum, expiration and recovery must remain fail-closed and production-blocked.
